title: Bookmark Shot: keep the lines you love from any book
description: Photograph a page and run a finger over a sentence you love. Only that line is saved as text, with the book and page number. All of it free.

demo.title: Have a go
demo.lead: Run a finger or your mouse over any sentence on the page below. Only the words you cross end up on the card.
demo.author: Emily Brontë
demo.text: If all else perished, and he remained, I should still continue to be; and if all else remained, and he were annihilated, the universe would turn to a mighty stranger: I should not seem a part of it. My love for Linton is like the foliage in the woods: time will change it, I'm well aware, as winter changes the trees. My love for Heathcliff resembles the eternal rocks beneath: a source of little visible delight, but necessary. Nelly, I am Heathcliff!
demo.empty: Swipe over a sentence and it will appear here.
demo.note: The web demo uses a ready-made page. The app reads the text from a photo you take. On a keyboard, Tab to a phrase and press Enter to add or remove it.

problem.title: Where do the good lines end up?
problem.text: It's a library book, so you can't write in it. A photo of the page sinks among thousands in your camera roll. Type it into a notes app and the title and page number rarely come along. Bookmark Shot keeps the sentence, the book and the page with two gestures: snap, then swipe.

features.title: Wonky photo, straight page
features.text:
After you photograph a page, line up the four corners and even a slanted shot is flattened like paper. Sharper letters mean better recognition.
Photos already in your library work too.

features.title: Every quote in one place
features.text:
Your books sit in a library of covers and your quotes gather in one list. Search by sentence, note or book title, and heart the ones you'd like to read again.
Add a book with a single cover shot. The title and author are read for you, and the ISBN too if the barcode on the back cover is in view.

features.title: Rediscover lines you'd forgotten
features.text:
Today's Quote brings back one of your saved quotes every day, along with the note you left. Keep it on your Home Screen or Lock Screen with a widget.
Love it? Turn it into a paper-style card and share it.

items.q: Are my photos or quotes sent anywhere?
items.a: No. Text recognition runs entirely on your device with Apple Vision, and your photos and quotes never go to a server. It works offline too. See the Privacy Policy below for details.

Text recognition is done by iOS on your device. It reads books in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Russian and most Western European languages, and on recent versions of iOS also Thai, Vietnamese, Turkish, Indonesian, Polish, Czech, Dutch and the Nordic languages. Greek can't be recognised yet.

items.q: How do I pick just the sentence I want?
items.a: After you photograph the page, run a finger over the sentence as if using a highlighter, and only those words are selected. Pinch to zoom for precision. There's also an eraser, Clear All and Whole Page.

items.q: The title or author came out wrong.
items.a: Cover recognition guesses from the size of the lettering, so very decorative covers can catch it out. You can correct the title and author before saving the book.
It's read from the numbers along the edge of the photo. Just correct it in the page field before saving.

items.q: Can I see my quotes on more than one device?
items.a: Yes. If you're signed in to iCloud with the same Apple Account and iCloud Drive is turned on, your books and quotes sync automatically.

items.q: How do I add the widget?
items.a: Touch and hold the Home Screen, tap Edit > Add Widget, and choose Bookmark Shot. For the Lock Screen, touch and hold it, then tap Customise. Today's Quote appears there.
Check Settings > Bookmark Shot and make sure camera and photo access are allowed. Taking photos needs a real iPhone.
An iPhone running iOS 17.0 or later.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Send feedback from the app's Settings (gear) screen or email us at the address below. We usually reply within two or three days.
